# TSBS DevOps — High CPU Usage - 1 Hour

```{tags} reference, query-template, tsbs_devops
```

> [TSBS DevOps](../../tsbs-devops.md) benchmark · [all TSBS DevOps queries](index.md)

Hosts with CPU usage above threshold

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT hostname
FROM cpu
WHERE usage_user > 90
  AND time >= '2024-01-01 02:00:00'
  AND time < '2024-01-01 03:00:00'
```
